obligations.source_text: Independently test the assigned ordinary-language keyword cumulonimbus convective storm structure in one randomized, complex, photorealistic environmental portrait, using the supplied image only for visible adult appearance continuity and making the storm anatomy the primary legible subject.

bindings.storm_base_phrase: a broad dark cloud base sits low above the landscape or horizon
bindings.convective_tower_phrase: a massive cauliflower-textured tower rises continuously from the same cloud base
bindings.anvil_top_phrase: the upper cloud spreads into a flattened fibrous or striated anvil across the high sky
bindings.precipitation_shaft_phrase: a rain hail or virga shaft visibly descends from beneath the storm body
